modelKey.description: Catalog key of the requested model (e.g. nb990). Null when no catalog model is named. Never a key outside the catalog.

modelQuery.description: Human-readable model name, e.g. 'New Balance 990'. Null when no model is named.

brand.description: Brand in English (Nike, Adidas, New Balance, ...). Null when unknown.

minCondition.description: Minimum acceptable condition grade. Null when not stated.

hardMaxAmount.description: Maximum price in KRW. Only an explicit upper bound. Null when not stated.

sizeKr.description: Korean shoe size in mm (220-320). Null when not stated.

freeTextConditions.description: Remaining preferences in the buyer's own words (box, colorway, accessories). Null when none.

confidence.description: 0.0 to 1.0. Overall confidence that the draft matches the buyer's intent.
